_note: Pre-written synthetic personas for running the console without Claude credits.

personas.name: Maya Thompson
personas.background: Maya runs a food truck in downtown Lexington with three employees. She renews several state permits every year and loses a full day each time to in-person notarization.
personas.personal_impact: Every renewal costs her a day of sales, roughly $800, plus the drive to Frankfort.

personas.name: Dale Whitaker
personas.background: Dale has managed a thoroughbred farm off Paris Pike for twenty years. Between agricultural, equine and trailer permits he files paperwork with the state almost every quarter.
personas.personal_impact: He drives into town to find a notary for forms he could sign in a minute, and once missed a deadline because the mail was slow.

personas.name: Priya Raman
personas.background: Priya directs a small home health agency near UK HealthCare that employs 28 nurses and aides. Her agency license and each nurse's renewal paperwork require wet-ink signatures.
personas.personal_impact: Her office manager spends two days each renewal cycle chasing signatures and notary stamps instead of scheduling patient visits.

personas.name: Marcus Bell
personas.occupation: licensed electrician starting his own shop
personas.background: Marcus left a big contractor last year to open his own electrical business in north Lexington. He is still learning the state licensing process on top of running jobs.
personas.personal_impact: Getting his contractor license renewal notarized meant turning down a paying job that afternoon.
